name: salicylic acid + tolnaftate
uses: Uses: For the effective treatment of nail fungus, discoloration, thickening, splitting,crumbling and brittleness.
otcwarn: Do not use on children under 3 years of age unless directed by a doctor. Stop and ask a doctor if-irritation occurs-there is no improvement within 4 weeks. If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental ingestion,seek medical advice immediately or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
